Partnerships

Several ways
to work together.

We connect rigorous scientific inquiry with real-world applications, working flexibly across the public and private sectors.

Universities

Joint research, collaborative grants, academic exchange, and mentorship.

Businesses

Applied research, consulting, custom software, and technology transfer.

Government

Public-interest research, funding programmes, preparedness, and policy advice.

Philanthropy

Research support and partnerships that advance shared scientific questions.

Research & computational tools

Custom software, data analysis pipelines, mathematical models, and collaborative research shaped around your question.

Training & grant support

Workshops, seminars, apprenticeship, project design, and support for joint funding proposals.

Clear terms

Scope, fees, milestones, invoicing, confidentiality, and intellectual property are agreed for each engagement. Ongoing partnerships can evolve with the work.
